title: CLAUDE.md
text: fixed design code exists: MIR never ends R process (D4). MIR’s default error handler calls exit(1), MIR_init can reach handler installed. Every context gets zumir’s handler MIR_set_error_func, paths run patched, every entry R table recovery point. missed path kills analyst’s session. longjmp crosses consumer’s frames. Every zumir_ entry C API returns status code, every MIR_ entry shim traps records error context, can freed (§4.3, D20). trap set one call never covers later one. MIR update can break consumers’ binaries. table carries MIR ABI number; bump whenever exposed mir.h enum struct changes (D21). C API table grows. first field version, later versions append fields. Consumers compiled older header must keep working. exit, abort, stdout stderr shared object (§11). MIR’s output goes buffer becomes R condition’s message. interpreter shareable across threads (D10): one interpreted function called eight threads gave wrong answers spike. tier thread compiles context; native code shared. rfunction() answers R errors (D16): every non-NaN result equals R’s bit bit, matching R cheap refuses. tests compare R identical(num.eq = FALSE) (#21). cfunction() reads system header (D5), import resolver resolves fixed list D6. Anything else link error, source behaves everywhere can’t reach R’s internals. MIR’s symbols hidden Stage 2, can’t clash another package vendors MIR.

title: Get started with zumir
text: rfunction() takes numeric R function compiles native code. result arguments returns exactly R function returns. accepts doubles, loops indices, conditions usual maths; anything else refused construct named.
code: csum_r <- function(x) {   y <- numeric(length(x))   acc <- 0   for (i in seq_along(x)) {     acc <- acc + x[i]     y[i] <- acc   }   y } csum <- rfunction(csum_r)  x <- c(1, 2, NA, 4) csum(x) identical(csum(x), csum_r(x))

title: Get started with zumir
text: cfunction() takes source one C function returns R function calls . Arguments named allocated returned. Lengths come int argument name.
code: # Open: should one source hold several functions, returned as a list? (Q2) sq <- cfunction("   void sq(int n, const double *x, double *y) {     for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) y[i] = x[i] * x[i];   }", out = "y", n = "n")  sq(x = c(1, 2, 3))

title: Get started with zumir
text: function returns int double gives value back directly. Arguments can int, double, const int *, const double *, int * double *. source may use C maths library memory string functions, can’t include system headers call R’s API.
code: dot <- cfunction("   double dot(int n, const double *x, const double *y) {     double s = 0;     for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s += x[i] * y[i];     return s;   }", n = "n")  dot(x = c(1, 2, 3), y = c(4, 5, 6))

title: Get started with zumir
